Reference image role: identity, costume and workshop-courtyard setting. Preserve the SAME fictional Indonesian woman, face, age, skin tone, black low ponytail, olive cotton overshirt, charcoal shirt, dark jeans and brown boots. Preserve realistic pores, fabric texture and believable anatomy. No additional people, no typography, no watermark, no beauty retouching, no illustration or CGI. The teaching variable must be unmistakably visible. Teaching item: Heat shimmer. Intended optics/look: Udara panas • di atas aspal/sumber panas. Visual objective: Distorsi dominan pada latar di atas sumber, bukan wajah seluruh bingkai.. Direction: Localized heat shimmer above sunlit asphalt, distant refraction, sharp foreground face.. Same woman standing sharply focused in foreground of the courtyard. Strong hot sun on asphalt beyond, localized wavy heat-refraction shimmer visibly distorts ONLY distant doorway/building edges above the hot ground. Near face stays sharp. No blur filter on whole image. Keep IDENTICAL centered waist-up frontal pose, eye-level 50mm perspective and workshop courtyard layout as the portrait reference; vary ONLY the specified atmosphere/weather and its physically motivated effects on hair, fabric, light and background visibility.

notes: Same reference identity. Educational interpretations; not calibrated stock/optical simulations. Camera diagrams intentionally unchanged.
